verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a public API in depth. It covers API credentials with configurable permissions and expiry, rate-limit response headers, synchronous, asynchronous and batch screening endpoints, and API-driven review and remediation of cases, alerts and risks. A Postman collection and a downloadable OpenAPI schema are also provided. The probe found no OpenAPI file at the guessed default paths, but that does not contradict the documented download from the docs page. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage, and an OpenAPI schema verified at a machine-discoverable URL.
